SubMenus.Label: Addendum
SubMenus.Description:
Addendum to an issued permit.  If a permit has been issued and changes are needed to be incorporated into the approved plans, you will need to submit an addendum permit.  A full set of plans is required and not just the pages that have changed.  If nothing has changed on the architectural plans, but the structural plans have changed and separate uploads or architectural and structural plans were originally submitted, you will only need to submit a full set of the plans that changed -- structural in this scenario. 

A full set of the plans is necessary to reduce confusion to both the subcontractors and to our inspectors when changes occur.

SubMenus.Label: Access Control Permit
SubMenus.Description: An Access Control Plan review is required when adding new, and/or reactivating and/or relocating existing access control devices. Installation, reactivation or relocation of any device will require a plan review submittal including a floor plan showing the location(s) of the device(s), and specification sheets for the equipment involved. Scope of work explanation must be included with plans. Refer to the 2012 Edition of the International Fire and Building Codes for specific requirements. Entrance doors to buildings and to tenant spaces which are secured by magnetic locks must release upon: 1). Activation of a motion sensor on the egress side. 2). Loss of power to the magnetic lock. 3). Activation of a manual unlocking device (usually a red “mushroom” button) located within 5-feet of the door. 4). Activation of the building fire alarm system. NOTE: Stairwell doors in multi-story buildings must unlock from the stair side as well as the egress side.

SubMenus.Label: Fire Alarm Permit

CaseTypeInfo.SuccessMessage: Your permit has been successfully submitted.

SubMenus.Description:
A Fire Alarm Plan review is required when adding new and/or relocating fire alarm related panels and devices. A separate address, floor, suite or system requires a separate submittal and permit. Please do not include more than one job with this submittal. Installation of a fire system related panel will require a cut sheet and battery calculations. A full set of plans and equipment submittals are required. (Exclude equipment list if only relocating). Refer to the latest edition of the IBC, IFC, IMC and Town of Addison Ordinances for specific fire alarm requirements. The Town of Addison recognizes the most recent edition of the NEC. Per NFPA 72, strobes in view of one another must synchronize even if on separate systems. You will be
responsible to see that your devices synchronize with existing devices – plan accordingly.

This submittal and plans must follow the Fire Alarm Plan Submittal Form requirements, which can be found on the Town’s Fire Department – Fire Prevention webpage. The Fire Alarm Submittal Form must be completed and attached as part of this submittal.

SubMenus.Label: Fire Sprinkler Permit
SubMenus.Description: A Fire Sprinkler Plan review is required when installing a new fire sprinkler system or modifying an existing system. This submittal and plans must follow the Fire Sprinkler Plan Submittal Form requirements, which can be found on the Town’s Fire Department – Fire prevention webpage. The Fire Sprinkler Submittal Form must be completed and attached as part of this submittal.

SubMenus.Label: Kitchen Hood System Permit
SubMenus.Description:
A Kitchen Hood System Plan review is required when a business, facility, or organization proposes to perform cooking operations that will release grease-laden vapors. All commercial cooking operations shall conform to the 2012 International Fire Code, as adopted and amended by the Town of Addison NFPA 17 and NFPA 17A. Submittal requires: 1). Valid documentation from the system manufacturer on equipment to be installed (Spec sheets). 2). An approved method (a physical positioning system) shall be provided that will ensure that the appliance is returned to an approved design location (NFPA 96 12.1.2.3.1).  3). Submit a floor plan clearly showing all of the following: a. Show hood and duct dimensions; b. Show appliance descriptions and dimensions; c. Show piping, valves, detectors, nozzles, manual pull, tank size and location; d. Number of Flow Points per tank, Number of Flow Points used on this hood system.

This submittal and plans must follow the Kitchen Hood System Plan Submittal Form requirements, which can be found on the Town’s Fire Department – Fire Prevention webpage. The Kitchen Hood System Plan Submittal Form must be completed and attached as part of this submittal

CaseTypeInfo.SuccessMessage: Your application has been successfully submitted.

Plans are required and must follow the associated checklists, which can be found on the Town’s Planning and Zoning webpage.

SubMenus.Label: Zoning Change

A description of the request and proposed use of the property is required. This submittal requires a Site Plan, Floor Plan, Façade Plans, Landscape/Irrigation Plan, and Preliminary Utility/Drainage Plans. All plans must follow the associated checklists, which can be found on the Town’s Planning and Zoning webpage.

SubMenus.Label: Special Use Permit Request

This submittal requires a Site Plan, Floor Plan, and Façade Plans (in some instances, Landscape/Irrigation Plan and Preliminary Utility/Drainage Plans may be required as well). All plans must follow the associated checklists, which can be found on the Town’s Planning and Zoning webpage.

SubMenus.Label: Civil Construction Review
SubMenus.Description: This is a full Civil Construction Review for new development or redevelopment involving site plan changes, landscape changes, and utility/drainage plan changes on a property. This review and approval is required before a Building Permit can be issued. Plans are required and must follow the associated checklists, which can be found on the Town’s Planning and Zoning webpage.
